definitions.explanation: Cancer arising in the stomach. Historically one of the most common cancers in Japan, which is why gastric screening is a standard part of adult health check-ups.

examples.japanese: {胃癌|いがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was diagnosed with stomach cancer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胃癌|いがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Early-stage stomach cancer has a high chance of being cured.

examples.japanese: {胃癌|いがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{四十歳|よんじゅっさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Once you pass forty, you should have regular screenings for stomach cancer.

notes:
⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach) + ⟦{癌|がん}→癌：02629_gan⟧ (cancer), with rendaku voicing がん to a compound reading いがん. Often written {胃|い}がん in newspapers, since ⟦{癌|がん}→癌：02629_gan⟧ is outside the common-use kanji list.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃癌|いがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop stomach cancer
- {胃癌|いがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: surgery for stomach cancer
- {胃癌|いがん}⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧: gastric cancer screening
- ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧{胃癌|いがん}: early-stage stomach cancer

RELATED WORDS:
- {肺癌|はいがん}: lung cancer
- {大腸癌|だいちょうがん}: colon cancer
- ⟦{胃炎|いえん}→胃炎：25491_ien⟧: gastritis
